title: Zammer Lochputz Klammerlebnis
highlights: Tirols mystische Klamm mit tosendem Loetzer Wasserfall und Felsformationen
Gesicherter Wasserfallweg ueber Stege, Stollen und die spektakulaere Haengebruecke
Historisches Schaukraftwerk mit Vorfuehrung alter Turbinen- und Stromerzeugung
Spiegelhoehle und mystischer Felsenkopf des Zammer Stiers
kurzbeschreibung: The Zammer Lochputz in Zams is a mystical natural monument featuring a rocky gorge, a showcase power plant, and a thundering waterfall.
beschreibung:
Natural Wonder and the Primal Power of Water

The Zammer Lochputz is considered one of the most impressive gorges in the Tiroler Oberland. Over millennia, the Lötzbach carved its way deep into the rock, creating a wild ravine filled with waterfalls, natural basins, and legendary rock formations centered around the myth of the Zammer Stier.

Adventure Trail and Showcase Power Plant

A secure walkway guides visitors across bridges and through rock tunnels right up to the roaring cascades. In the adjacent showcase power station, guests gain captivating insights into the historical and modern harness of hydropower in Tirol.
